source_title: MEDKids Pancreas starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How insulin helps regulate blood sugar
educational_content: The pancreas is an organ behind the stomach. The pancreas makes a hormone called insulin. Insulin helps sugar move from the blood into the body's cells. Cells use sugar for energy. The pancreas also makes juices that help digest food.
learning_objectives: Insulin helps sugar move from the blood into cells.

forbidden_claims.claim: Insulin is made in the stomach
